descricao: Ensure that the confidentiality obligation term is 1 year, accepting a maximum of 2 years, counted from the signing or closing of negotiations, as negotiated.
exemplos: Clause providing for confidentiality for an indefinite term.
Clause imposing confidentiality obligation for more than 2 years.
Absence of clear definition of when the confidentiality term begins and ends.
localizacao_tipica: Agreement Termination or Validity Chapter (e.g., clause 3.x)

descricao: Restrict the definition of 'Representatives' to not include GPs or related parties that are not directly involved in the opportunity, avoiding unnecessary conflicts of interest.
exemplos: Definition of Representatives that generically includes 'affiliates' without limitation.
Clause that expands Representatives to any person linked to Spectra's economic group.
Sections mentioning that any fund or vehicle managed by Spectra is considered a Representative for liability purposes.
localizacao_tipica: Definitions Clause (e.g., clause 2.1.1 or definitions section)

descricao: Avoid broad non-circumvention clauses; limit, when necessary, only to direct negotiation with third parties linked to the same opportunity, without restricting Spectra's general business.
exemplos: Clause prohibiting Spectra from doing any business with companies in the sector, regardless of the specific opportunity.
Text preventing Spectra from speaking with any investor or disclosed target, even for other unrelated transactions.
Non-circumvention extending for several years without scope limitation.
localizacao_tipica: General Provisions or specific exclusivity clause

descricao: Spectra's liability must be limited to indemnification for judicially proven direct damages, expressly excluding lost profits, indirect damages, consequential damages, and immaterial damages.
exemplos: Clause mentioning 'damages and losses, including lost profits and indirect damages'.
Text providing for liability for 'any resulting losses, direct or indirect'.
Provision of disproportionate penalty without connection to damage actually proven in court.
localizacao_tipica: Damage Compensation or Liability Chapter (e.g., clause 4.x)

descricao: Restrict non-solicitation to direct hiring of employees/collaborators for a maximum period of 1 year, with exceptions for candidates who contact spontaneously or via general advertisement.
exemplos: Non-solicitation with term exceeding 12 months.
Prohibition on hiring former collaborators even after termination of relationship with the other party.
Clause prohibiting hiring even in public selection processes or via recruitment consulting.
localizacao_tipica: General Provisions or specific non-solicitation clause

descricao: Preference for Brazilian law and jurisdiction of São Paulo/SP, with waiver of any other jurisdiction, whenever possible in negotiation.
exemplos: Jurisdiction defined outside São Paulo, such as Rio de Janeiro or foreign jurisdiction.
Clause allowing the counterparty to choose alternative jurisdiction at its discretion.
Absence of jurisdiction clause, leaving room for future discussions.
localizacao_tipica: Final Chapter on Applicable Law and Jurisdiction (e.g., clause 6.x)

descricao: Ensure that the following are not considered confidential information: (i) information already in Spectra's possession before the NDA; (ii) publicly available information; (iii) information received from third parties not bound by confidentiality obligation, in good faith; and (iv) information required by regulatory or judicial authority.
exemplos: Clause that does not mention the exception for information already known by Spectra.
Absence of exception for information required by CVM or other authorities.
Text requiring prior authorization from the disclosing party for any disclosure to regulatory body.
localizacao_tipica: Confidentiality exceptions clause (e.g., clause 2.6, 2.7 or similar)
